summary: If incessant hoops, breaks its loops children tire maybe so inspired redo CSS timing so wait time stops climbing on phrases short restore balance in prosody of pixelated mated words while stretching oddity with sounds to be heard #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
If incessant hoops, breaks its loops
children tire
maybe so inspired
redo CSS timing
so wait time stops climbing
on phrases short
restore balance in prosody of pixelated
mated words while
stretching oddity with sounds to be heard
#smallpoems
